WalkPacing.DefaultMaxDetailPages is removed or kept only as the documented value the old default had; with --max N given, the walk behaves exactly as it does today; proven by walk tests over the recorded fixtures for both cases, including one where an uncapped pair visits every link of a multi-page search\u0022,\u0022Before the first detail page of each pair, the walk prints how many detail pages it is about to visit for that pair (links after known cards are removed and the cap, if any, applied), and the start of the run prints the per-pair totals it already knows, so the operator can judge the run\\u0027s length at about a minute per page; the per-pair line and end table are otherwise unchanged; proven by a test over the console output\u0022,\u0022The README\\u0027s walk section (or docs/walk.md if the docs split has landed) says the walk is uncapped by default, that --max limits it, that a repeat walk visits only new cars, and gives the rough pace; dotnet build and dotnet test succeed with zero warnings; commits are small with conventional messages, no em dashes, no AI attribution\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Feature\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022Brian\\u0027s direction on 2026-09-26, relayed by run session odonomics-59, in his words: \\u0027we should raise this cap significantly because I want to crawl all the cars. That\\u0027s kind of the point of having this be pseudo-automated, because I\\u0027m not crawling 159 cars; the system is. It dumps, pulls in the data, tries to filter out what it can, and then that allows us to get better results over searching.\\u0027 He was told an uncapped walk today is plausibly 300 to 400 pages and 5 to 7 hours at about a minute per page, growing with the ledger, and accepted it. Evidence from walk run 5 that the cap binds: carvana / Camry Hybrid states 149 cars, walk saved 30 of 34 visited; carvana / Corolla Hybrid 59 cars, saved 30 of 33; cars.com / Camry Hybrid saved 30 from page 1 of its two searches. Blocked on 726ebd91 (card-based skipping of known postings) because an uncapped walk without it revisits every known car on every run; 238da0a2 (cars.com paging) is independent and should land before or beside this. Code: src/Odonomics/Cli/Commands/WalkCommand.cs CreateMaxOption (line 30, DefaultValueFactory = WalkPacing.DefaultMaxDetailPages) and the maxDetailPages parameter threaded through RunAsync and WalkPairAsync; src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkPacing.cs line 16 holds the constant 30; the pool size today is maxDetailPages times WalkSite.DetailLinkOverfetchMultiplier, which has no meaning without a cap; src/Odonomics/Walk/WalkSearchPages.cs CollectLinksAsync takes poolSize. Keep the pacing itself (scroll pauses, gaps between pages) exactly as it is; this task changes how many pages, not how fast. Do not touch the run skill file in the project home; the orchestrator updates
